$about: The second half of a case whose first half shipped separately. The 2026-08-04 evidence for this case bundled two findings; the CI-gate half was fixed in core/pull/35 and this run closes the other, which had been recorded as deliberately open. Reproduced from clean fixtures before anything was changed, and the recorded numbers were re-measured rather than carried over - one of them did not hold.

observations.evidence: Both halves are now closed. The CI-gate half (a workflow file is not a gate that fires) landed in core/pull/35. This run closes the stub-substance half. Reproduced on a sparse adopting repo carrying the manifest, the pin and the verifier and nothing else: adding six files whose entire body is `# Title` and `TODO.` moved it from `drift 19 - 21% adopted (5/24)` to `drift 19 - 37% adopted (11/30)` - sixteen percentage points for six files that say nothing, with real substance and drift both unchanged. The recorded 25%-vs-12% figures did NOT reproduce as stated and are corrected here: on the full shipped tree the same experiment moves the percentage not at all (99% both ways, 4 more entries scored adopted), because the denominator moves with the numerator - the gap only appears on a sparse repo, which is the shape the original reading was taken on. Root cause confirmed: `fill-from-repo` entries carry neither a `sha256` (a `copy` entry's check, added in e42d39a) nor `requiredKeys` (a `merge` entry's), and by construction can carry neither, since the adopter writes the content. Two contributing defects found while fixing it: the existing placeholder warning recognised only SURVIVING TEMPLATE placeholders, so a stub the adopter typed themselves was invisible to it; and it walked a hardcoded list of eight files that `CONTRIBUTING.md` - a fill-from-repo entry - was never on, a second source of truth beside the manifest. Resolved by ADR-038 rather than by deepening the check: required sections per entry and a length threshold were both considered and rejected in writing, the first because it converts substance into ceremony (add the heading, write TODO under it) and the second because it measures prose by the yard and would fail a genuine two-sentence SECURITY.md. What shipped: the file list is derived from the manifest; a warning (never drift) fires on a body with no content beyond its headings or whose entire content is a nothing-yet marker; and the verdict line states that the percentage counts entries present, not substance written. Verified on the stubbed sparse repo: `drift 19 - 37% adopted (11/30), 0 excepted - 19 required entries are unmet - 6 authored files flagged above as unfilled or empty: this percentage counts entries present, not substance written`. Five cases added to tools/self-verify-fill-test.mjs covering the boundary in both directions; neutralising the check turns exactly the three positive cases red and leaves the two negative ones green, so a check that warned about everything would fail the same tests as one that warned about nothing.
